verdicts.reason: I can't see a meaningful difference between the two layouts. Both use the same left-to-right banner: headline, window, then details. In both, the stained-glass window has shrunk to a small icon and is no longer the centrepiece it is in the original. Wide empty gaps separate the three groups, and the headline sits tight against the top and left edges. The date and address text is very small at this height, so both need margin and scale fixes before shipping.
